lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb4Si4C12 (reduced formula TbSiC3) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/d (No. 143), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers with 10 geometric neighbors (8 C, 1 Tb, 1 Si) and silicon centers with 5 C neighbors, while Tb centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 C neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among C-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, with edge- and face-sharing also observed between C- and Tb-centered polyhedra.
